sections.heading: 1. Readiness Check
sections.body: Instructors assess a trainee's practical competence — normally after a minimum of 9 months of training, though this can be sooner depending on ability.

sections.heading: 2. Placement
sections.body: PTI works with industry and workplace partners connected to the trainee's department (Engineering, Business, Hospitality, ICT, Agriculture, or Nursery Teaching) to place trainees where their specific skill applies.

sections.heading: 3. Supervised Attachment
sections.body: Trainees work at the partner organisation under joint supervision, applying what they learned in the workshop, kitchen, lab, or farm unit to live workplace tasks.

sections.heading: 4. Testimonial & Certification
sections.body: On completion, the partner organisation issues a testimonial, and the trainee proceeds toward DIT and UBTEB Trade Test examinations for final certification.
